name: kenspc
description: Structured software development workflows for Claude Code, aligned with Claude 5 generation guidance (last reviewed 2026-09-23): effort follows the session, with three xhigh overrides (unattended implementation and fixing, multi-round planning). Eleven reusable subagents drive brief generation, plan generation, task decomposition, automated batch implementation, and multi-angle parallel review. v3 follows five design rules: workflow SOP stays, business rules framed as why-not-command, DONE-criteria over step-by-step flow, no anti-rationalization scaffolding, and plain language over MUST/NEVER/CRITICAL/ULTRATHINK.
